headerDisplay: Each alert becomes a HomeKit switch. Turn it on and PagerDuty pages someone. Turn it off and the alert resolves. Use HomeKit automations to turn the switches on, for example: when the leak sensor detects water, turn on Leak.
footerDisplay: The integration key is stored in the Homebridge configuration file, like every Homebridge credential, and is never written to the log. The [documentation](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-pagerduty#readme) explains each setting.

routingKey.title: Integration Key
routingKey.description: From an Events API v2 integration on the PagerDuty service that should be paged.

region.title: Service Region
region.description: Choose EU if your PagerDuty address ends in .eu.pagerduty.com.

source.title: Source
source.description: Shown on each alert in PagerDuty. If two Homebridge installs share one integration key, give each a different source. Resolve open alerts before you change it.

id.title: Alert ID
id.description: A short, permanent ID, such as leak. If you change it, HomeKit replaces the switch and loses its room and automations.

name.title: Accessory Prefix
name.description: Each severity below adds a HomeKit switch named with this prefix and the severity, such as Leak Critical. It also labels this alert in the Homebridge log. Safe to rename.

summary.title: PagerDuty Message
summary.description: Sent to PagerDuty when any of this alert's switches turns on, with that switch's severity.

levels.title: Severity
levels.description: Most alerts need one severity. Add another only when the same problem can be more or less urgent, such as Leak Warning and Leak Critical.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Use a different severity for each level.

resolveAfterMinutes.title: Turn Off After (minutes)
resolveAfterMinutes.description: Optional. Turns off every switch of this alert, which resolves it, this many minutes after the last time any of them turned on.

bypassMaintenance.title: Page During Maintenance
bypassMaintenance.description: Page even while the maintenance switch is on. Use it for alerts that must never wait.

switch.title: Maintenance Switch
switch.description: Adds a maintenance switch to HomeKit. While it is on, new alerts wait, and they are sent when it turns off. Resolves are always sent.

name.title: Switch Name
name.description: The name that HomeKit shows. You can rename it at any time, and it keeps its room and automations.

maxMinutes.title: Turn Off After (minutes)
maxMinutes.description: The maintenance switch turns itself off after this long, so a forgotten switch cannot hold alerts forever.

deliveryFaultSensor.title: Delivery Fault Sensor
deliveryFaultSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor to HomeKit. It opens when an alert could not be delivered for two minutes, so HomeKit can tell you that nobody may have been paged.

deliveryFaultSensorName.title: Sensor Name
deliveryFaultSensorName.description: The name that HomeKit shows. You can rename it at any time, and it keeps its room and automations.

dryRun.title: Dry Run
dryRun.description: Log each event instead of sending it. Useful while you build automations.

diagnosticsInterval.title: Diagnostics Interval (seconds)
diagnosticsInterval.description: Write a health line to the Homebridge log every N seconds. 0 turns it off. Values from 1 to 29 are raised to 30.

structuredLogs.title: JSON Diagnostics
structuredLogs.description: Also write each health line as JSON.

layout.title: HomeKit Alerts
layout.description: One alert for each thing that should page someone, such as a water leak or a smoke alarm.

layout.title: Maintenance
layout.description: A switch that holds new alerts while you work on the house.

layout.title: Plugin Signals
layout.description: Signals from other plugins that support homebridge-pagerduty. Each plugin appears here after it and this plugin have both started.
